real_paper_examples.input_scope: Source conclusion lines1717–1747, plus first-page identity; original source is local and not redistributed.
real_paper_examples.input_fact_summary: New degradation functions permit study of shape effects independent of regularization length. Standard quadratic functions delay crack propagation and overestimate critical loads; adjusting length cannot fix that problem. Proper calibration improves accuracy. The current reduced-parameter formulation preserving prefracture linear response still has a spurious bulk-energy dip after nucleation; reducing length alleviates it with greater mesh cost.
real_paper_examples.output_zh: 新的能量退化函数族区分了函数形状与相场正则化长度对脆性断裂响应的影响。标准二次退化函数导致的裂纹扩展起始延迟和临界载荷过估，不能仅靠调整正则化长度消除；所提函数在适当校准后提高了模拟精度。当前保留断裂前线弹性响应的简化校准仍会引入起裂后的伪能量下降，减小正则化长度虽可缓解这一问题，也增加了网格成本。准确描述起裂因而需要审视退化函数的形式及其校准，不能只调整长度参数。
real_paper_examples.output_en: The proposed degradation functions distinguish the influence of function shape from that of the phase-field regularization length in brittle-fracture simulations. The delayed crack propagation and excessive critical loads produced by the standard quadratic function cannot be corrected solely by changing this length. Appropriate calibration improves accuracy, but the present reduced-parameter formulation, which preserves the prefracture linear response, still produces a spurious decrease in bulk energy after crack nucleation. A smaller regularization length alleviates this artifact at greater meshing cost. Accurate prediction therefore requires attention to the degradation function and its calibration, rather than reliance on length adjustment alone.

checks.truth_conditions: pass: proper calibration and current formulation are retained; length effects on old overprediction and new energy dip are not conflated.
checks.evidence_strength: pass: numerical improvement is not called an analytical proof or experimental validation.
checks.counterexample_and_tradeoff: pass: standard-function failure and residual artifact/cost remain explicit.
checks.no_new_data: pass: no invented accuracy, time or cost percentages.
checks.no_new_causal_claim: pass: relationships and interpretation restate those explicitly discussed by the source.
checks.bilingual_equivalence: pass: both languages retain the same condition, artifact and cost tradeoff.

real_paper_examples.input_scope: Source conclusion lines751–768; necessary result/data-generation context lines554–557,643–646,720–745 read separately.
real_paper_examples.input_fact_summary: NN-EUCLID learns hyperelasticity without stress labels using displacement and global-force inputs and momentum-balance constraints. Isotropic/anisotropic benchmarks use synthetic FEM data with added noise. Generalization and FEM deployment are demonstrated for tested states/geometries; significant mismatch appears at larger strains beyond training coverage. Experimental validation and inelastic extension remain future work.
real_paper_examples.output_zh: NN-EUCLID以位移场和整体反力为输入，通过动量平衡约束学习超弹性本构关系，免去了应力标签。各向同性与各向异性的合成基准表明，模型能够识别材料响应和纤维方向，并推广到部分未见的应变状态及试样几何，供有限元计算使用。较大变形下仍存在偏差，因而不能将这些结果解释为任意加载下的外推保证。现有证据来自数值基准，实验验证和非弹性行为的扩展仍有待开展。
real_paper_examples.output_en: NN-EUCLID identifies hyperelastic constitutive relations from displacement fields and global forces by enforcing momentum balance, without stress labels. Synthetic isotropic and anisotropic benchmarks demonstrate recovery of material response and fiber orientation, together with generalization to some unseen strain states and specimen geometries and deployment in finite element calculations. Discrepancies at larger deformations preclude a claim of unrestricted extrapolation. The present evidence is numerical; experimental validation and extension to inelastic behavior remain future work.

checks.truth_conditions: pass: hyperelasticity, synthetic data and tested generalization scope are retained.
checks.evidence_strength: pass: realistically measurable input is not misrepresented as an actual physical experiment.
checks.counterexample_and_tradeoff: pass: larger-strain mismatch read from the directly related results is retained instead of blindly repeating the broad source summary.
checks.no_new_data: pass: no invented error or speed numbers.
checks.no_new_causal_claim: pass: does not claim physical constraints guarantee generalization for every material or loading.
checks.bilingual_equivalence: pass: both distinguish numerical evidence and future experimental validation.

real_paper_examples.input_scope: Source complete conclusion lines1042–1085 and first-page identity.
real_paper_examples.input_fact_summary: In shallow aluminum-bicrystal nanoindentation, initial pop-in involves first dislocation activation/nucleation; later pop-ins mainly involve grain-boundary transmission and intermittent sources. Hardness varies with indenter-boundary distance and depth. A pile-up-based modified Hall-Petch model accounts for GND accumulation and the coexistence of increasing GND density with decreasing overall hardness. Applicability assumes no pre-existing dislocations in the probed volume.
real_paper_examples.output_zh: 铝双晶浅纳米压痕中的初始突跳与位错的首次激活或形核相关，后续突跳主要来自晶界透射及位错源的间歇活动。晶界距离与压入深度共同影响硬度，位错塞积模型据此给出的修正Hall–Petch关系能够描述几何必需位错的积累，并解释其密度增加与总体硬度降低可以同时出现的现象。该描述限于压头作用区无预存位错、塑性主要由压头附近位错产生控制的浅压痕，不能直接推广到已有体内位错源主导的情形。
real_paper_examples.output_en: In shallow nanoindentation of aluminum bicrystals, the initial pop-in is associated with the first activation or nucleation of dislocations, whereas later events mainly involve grain-boundary transmission and intermittent source activity. Hardness depends jointly on indentation depth and distance to the boundary. A pile-up-based modification of the Hall–Petch relation accounts for geometrically necessary dislocation accumulation and explains why increasing dislocation density can coexist with decreasing overall hardness. This description applies to shallow indentation into volumes without pre-existing dislocations, where plasticity is controlled by dislocation generation near the indenter. It does not establish validity when pre-existing bulk sources dominate.

checks.truth_conditions: pass: shallow indentation and absence of pre-existing dislocations remain decisive conditions.
checks.evidence_strength: pass: a model interpretation is not presented as a universal experimentally proved law.
checks.counterexample_and_tradeoff: pass: increasing GND density with decreasing overall hardness is retained.
checks.no_new_data: pass: no material constants, thresholds or statistics added.
checks.no_new_causal_claim: pass: distinguishes initial versus later events and does not replace the source mechanism with a generic Taylor hardening claim.
checks.bilingual_equivalence: pass: same applicable regime, events and nonmonotonic interpretation.

real_paper_examples.zh: 高质量一至九层氮化硼纳米片的压痕测试表明，少层氮化硼保持了接近单层的强度，其厚度依赖性不同于石墨烯。单层氮化硼的杨氏模量为0.865±0.073 TPa，断裂强度为70.5±5.5 GPa。包含层间相互作用的计算与简化梁模型将这种差别联系到压痕附近的滑移：石墨烯层更容易相对滑动，而氮化硼层的滑移受到抑制。
real_paper_examples.en: Indentation measurements on high-quality one- to nine-layer boron nitride nanosheets show that few-layer BN retains strength comparable to the monolayer, unlike the thickness-dependent weakening observed in graphene. Monolayer BN has a Young’s modulus of 0.865 ± 0.073 TPa and a fracture strength of 70.5 ± 5.5 GPa. Calculations including interlayer interactions and simplified beam models link this contrast to sliding near the indentation site: graphene layers slide more readily, whereas sliding in BN is suppressed.

real_paper_examples.input_fact_summary: A long-wavelength homogenized lattice model, compact periodic design parameterization and optimization method are introduced. The isotruss has higher stiffness-to-density ratio than octet while remaining elastically isotropic. Model accuracy is low-frequency and excludes local buckling. A simple gradient method is used; nonconvex optimization convergence needs further attention. Spatial designs additionally need cell-placement compatibility/constructibility constraints.
real_paper_examples.output_zh: 晶格的长波均匀化模型与周期胞元参数化相结合，使构型设计可围绕刚度和强度目标展开。所得isotruss在保持弹性各向同性的同时，比八面体桁架具有更高的刚度密度比。这一结果适用于所建模型的低频响应；模型不包含局部屈曲，所用优化也未确立非凸问题的全局最优。将单胞优化推广到空间变构型，还需保证相邻胞元的几何兼容，才能形成可制造结构。
real_paper_examples.output_en: A long-wavelength homogenized model and a periodic unit-cell parameterization enable lattice architectures to be designed for stiffness and strength objectives. The resulting isotruss combines elastic isotropy with a higher stiffness-to-density ratio than the octet truss. These results concern the model’s low-frequency response; local buckling is excluded, and the optimization does not establish a global optimum for nonconvex objectives. Extending unit-cell optimization to spatially varying lattices also requires geometric compatibility between neighboring cells before the designs can be considered manufacturable.
